item.title: Curling draws crowds in Milan as Olympic organizers build excitement for 2026 Games
item.description: For the past year, Milan-Cortina Olympic organizers would set up temporary sports villages throughout the country hoping to get people to slow down for a few minutes. One of those temporary sports venues was for curling in the plaza outside the Duomo Cathedral.

item.title: Mikaela Shiffrin arrives in Cortina as women’s alpine skiing begins
item.description: The biggest names in women's alpine skiing are in Cortina, Italy. Mikaela Shiffrin is one of them.

item.title: West Valley Native Khyiris Tonga Prepares for First Super Bowl Appearance
item.description: Khyiris Tonga, the 29‑year‑old defensive tackle for the New England Patriots, will take the field this weekend in his first-ever Super Bowl.

item.title: Utah State Survives Upset-Minded Wyoming’s Late Comeback
item.description: Utah State survives a frenzied second-half Wyoming surge to earn an important 85-83 win over Wyoming to remain atop the Mountain West standings.

item.title: Jaren Jackson Jr. Shows Off In Orlando, Jazz Fall To Magic
item.description: The Utah Jazz successfully debuted big man Jaren Jackson Jr. in a loss to the Orlando Magic 120-117.

item.title: Former Weber State Teammate Reflects on Rashid Shaheed Ahead of Super Bowl
item.description: A former teammate of Seahawks wide receiver Rashid Shaheed said he’ll be watching this weekend’s Super Bowl with pride — and maybe a few nerves.

item.title: As Vonn prepares to compete in Cortina, her coach strikes optimistic tone
item.description: Aksel Lund Svindal, coach of Utah skier Lindsey Vonn, shared his hopes for Vonn's Olympic season after her recovery from her injury just over a week before.

item.title: Police: Surveillance images help to identify suspect in Utah hospital wallet theft
item.description: Police said a hospital worker was arrested Friday in connection with the theft of a wallet and cards from a 92-year-old woman who had been receiving medical care at St. Mark’s Hospital.

item.title: NFL Legacy: Luther Elliss reflects on son Christian ahead of Super Bowl
item.description: When Christian Elliss stepped onto the field for Super Bowl LX, he carried with him the legacy of three brothers in football and a retired father who loves his son.

item.title: No. 8 Houston Holds Off No. 16 BYU At Marriott Center
item.description: The losing streak extends to four games for BYU.
